Essence.1:
Present attitude toward life

There may be periods where they contemplate a need for independence or change where they aspire to do something new and creative under their own steam, something that involves them in a role allowing autonomous working conditions. The personality and traits of this individual may indicate the need for them to pursue their own ideas and use their own initiative toward a better outcome.

They enjoy the idea or desire, to experience new interests, opportunities, career, or to make connections with different people than those they have associated with previously. Their character and ability to manage some matters may be tested, and they may just have to simply decide to try things out, to see how they perform. This will reveal if they have made the right decision or not.

At times they may encounter resentment or resistance from others because of their desire to push and act on their independent ideas. They possess the drive and determination to break away from old conditions to make inroads where they see opportunity exists. Effort should be encouraged to improve their work habits such that they strive toward developing new techniques to match their changing working conditions. They will gain greater knowledge and understanding which will be to their advantage. It is advisable to ensure any new path they take does not give rise to detours that may lead them down untested roads purely based on a feeling and desire for change.
Essence.2:
Present attitude toward life

They have entered a quiet period of their life where they have to exercise patience and a more methodical approach to all they are involved with. Rushing anything at this time can cause losses due to missing some small but important details with everything they are doing. This is a good time for them to be making, or to become involved with others in any form.

Cooperation is very helpful at this time and their input will be highly valued. In fact, collaboration is one of the keys to their success. Even though they may be working in with others, there could be some feelings of subordination and this should be avoided. Any delays mean they will have to spend more time correcting matters and this may just be wasting time and delaying their progress. There should be no pressure placed on them during this period, even though present circumstances may demand more of their time and involvement to get things done.

Too much stress in one or more areas will only add discomfort to other personal life considerations that they have to deal with and their health may suffer. There is the possibility they will have a disruption in their partnerships and/or domestic affairs and possibly bring disturbances, delays and misunderstandings or feelings of loss and separation. As can be seen, this is not necessarily an exciting period for this person and feelings of being put down arise unless they are willing to get on with the ways and means of those around them.
Essence.3:
Present attitude toward life

At this point in time they are in a good position to expand their horizons and enjoy the possibility of becoming involved with any project that has a creative need. They are ready to utilize their creative abilities and to apply themselves with enthusiasm to any task at hand. They can apply forward movement now and improve their lot by brushing up on latent talents they will have only touched on in previous years.

They are in a mood to expand and create, so if the position they are working toward provides this type of opportunity, then they are ready for it. Constructive outlets such as art, music, literature and the more cultural aspects of living are in harmony with their present energies. Whatever the impact of what they are doing now, more imagination and optimism should be developed and worked on for them to expand their talent base.

This period also comes with an emotional draw card and therefore their feelings will be exaggerated to some degree. They may be full of enthusiasm one day and then the next, wear their heart on their sleeve. All happiness comes from achievement of some sort or other, and this person, if productively employed, and having the ability to express their talents, will be in a good frame of mind indeed. Any desire for self indulgent pleasures can bring an unproductive, time wasting and an over active social life. This will simply waste their energy and their employer’s time if it is not managed; a loss of position could result.
Essence.4:
Present attitude toward life

Their present feelings and aspirations reflect the hard work they are being subjected to and the need for them to organise matters in their career, domestic and social life. Any effort must be productively applied during this period. Wasting time and lessening their efforts when there is work to be done, will give rise to emotional and financial problems.

This is a practical period for them and a time to work on a project that requires their full attention and management skill. It may be that they are planning to build something, a project perhaps that is under their control or command; something that needs their full attention to complete no matter how long the exercise or project under consideration is. Effort is needed to place their affairs on a more stable level of living. The work that has to be done cannot be avoided.

There seems to be an increase in pressure to get things done. Emotions may come to the surface due to interactions with other people in their life that may also be calling for their attention, hence they may feel they are being pulled one way and then the other. Factors may come to the surface having to be addressed that show the situation as it really is and this may force them to make the effort to improve their current situation.

Planning, building, business matters or any other thing that calls for them to manage, must be done with good financial management as there is no room for mistakes. If things are overlooked and not paid due attention, problems will arise that will add unwanted pressure to bear and there may be no let up from this responsibility. Some old ways of doing things may be broken down to allow for improvement and this may cause things to slow down and seem to hold them back to some degree, but the reward in the end will make their efforts worthwhile.

One area that may present a need for consideration is their health and that of those they have close relationships with. There is the possibility that during this time they may be faced with problems or situations that place them in a position to reconcile their life. All care must be taken with whatever they do as there is little room for risk taking or dropping their guard to any challenging conditions they are subjected to. It is likely that some important decisions will be made during this time and this will affect them measurably.
Essence.5:
Present attitude toward life

There is a great deal of change affecting their thoughts and feelings at the present time. There is opportunity in every corner of their mind just waiting for somewhere to move toward. This means they are itching to do something that provides them with greater interest and the freedom to do as they please. This is not a productive thing unless it is well planned and the object of their exercise has a constructive outcome. Many things are happening to them and a variety of events, not necessarily expected will present themselves to this person for them to consider. It is a time for them to move on and accept opportunities to gain more freedom, and to develop new ideas to their work and personal interests.

This is a very active period for them and any work that involves public interests, travel or communications with many people, at any level of involvement, is a suitable exercise for them presently. Changes are due them. Each altered factor they encounter is but a growth and development lesson that they can handle as long as they have a positive attitude toward their work. However, too many irons in the fire can waste their energy and scatter their time schedules such that they encounter confusion or possibly even losses.

Honesty and integrity are important factors now, otherwise legal matters and arguments may arise making the period a serious one. Agreements in business and employment must be compliant with rules that prudently should be set in place well before any venture is engaged and given the go ahead. Mistakes at this stage are avoided with a lot of common sense and proper procedures set in place. Impulsive actions should be avoided.
Essence.6:
Present attitude toward life

This period brings for them a fair amount of responsibility to take care of others, work and personal matters. They are in a position to take the helm, whatever it is they are presently engaged, or potentially soon, becoming involved with. This can take the form of management, finance, supervisory at any level, health or even farming and horticulture as examples. This is a time where business improvements at every level can be made to enhance productivity. Staff management and internal organization are all part of their present capabilities. This coincides with their career and personal related matters and may include improving business or enhancing the look of their home. This is a time where they wish to improve 'things' across the board.

There may be aspects of their work that call for them to manage people of a domineering or selfish nature under their supervision. This may cause them to bring about necessary guidelines and control to enforce administrative leadership. Some skills may have to be learned and personal experience by involvement is the only way to bring this about. Honesty is paramount, during this phase of their career otherwise legal matters may ensue, as this is a time of responsibility and to help others and not just themselves. Their success comes through their helping and managing others to improve the quality of their life and station for the benefit of the whole.
Essence.7:
Present attitude toward life

This aspect of their personality, presently seeks improvement of their current situation. They are questioning themselves and considering what it is they should be doing and in what direction they should be headed. They may appear more quiet and reserved, but they are just trying to develop an inner awareness that will help them understand their lot in life and how they can improve matters around them.

It is probable that extra training or learning some new skill will enhance their position and allow for advancement in their chosen field. However, if they are feeling trapped or unable to advance because of some other influence; a spouse, a boss, or even where they are living and this is causing them restrictions such that they cannot move ahead, then they may withdraw and become very reserved.

If they have the choice or the opportunity to go into some sort of research area, they are well positioned and suited at this time. Any scientific field, research or even their seeking to further develop an existing product or service is right for them at this time. Business improvements or a career development or even writing up projects or following educational pursuits, will all bring results. This period can be a time of transition from one level of thinking to another. It is possible during this time that big lessons will be learned. This will be a part of the mental pressure they will have to endure before they reach an understanding of what it is that their life is lacking.

Until they can resolve in their own mind what it is they do not understand, problems will be reoccurring and there can be loss and separation. This will force their thinking in a new direction. This is actually a time of improvement, not a time of loss. They are in a growth stage and will attract what they are thinking about. They should be developing a better existence for themselves and those they are now associating with.
Essence.8:
Present attitude toward life

During this time these people are in a frame of mind where they have the energy and enthusiasm to manage larger projects. Opportunity is open to them to take a command position and to get things done on a large scale. Money can be made by their influence and activities but on a personal level, money should not be their objective. Financial rewards come only after the job has been done or the work has been put in to bring about the monetary rewards for their efforts.

A business activity can be built to last a long time if they manage both the people and the infrastructure of the project they are involved with. Risk taking at this time is not advisable unless all angles have been considered and due diligence has been undertaken to a high standard. Any mistakes at this time for them are a costly exercise indeed; not just financially but also by way of their reputation. It is highly likely travel due to business activities will arise and any opportunity in the printing or publishing arenas, or dealing with commercial advertising, is possible and very rewarding for them and their employer.

Matters of a personal nature involving their marriage or relationships are not their main focus at this time. Business matters are always in the forefront of their mind, but it is advisable to maintain a high level of communication with their loved ones or serious problems will arise. An efficient schedule and good financial management are most important at this time for them. They should follow all projects through to the end and keep their hand on the pulse of the work they are in control of. Constant attention must be paid to keeping themselves well balanced, mentally, financially and physically.
Essence.9:
Present attitude toward life

This is a demanding period of their life and it brings many demands for them to manage. There is a great deal of opportunity to develop a wide range of business activities. There are matters that need to be dealt with and gotten rid of, as they are hindering their progress, so if anything needs to be sold, ended or moved on from, now is the time for them to do so. This kind of activity can be associated with a career type that calls for reduction of business losses and downsizing personnel as a Company is restructuring.

There is a lot of weight placed on their shoulders but they are in a position to handle it. They must keep compliant with legal statutes and have consideration for the welfare and well-being of those they come into contact with. Because of their influential nature at this time, they can turn seemingly negative situations into positive ones by having an appreciation of the overall project and can see what needs to be done so that all options are taken into consideration, not just their boss or Company.

During this time, many different experiences will take place and there will be opportunities in business, or where people are concerned. This is possible at every level and not just large enterprises. The possibility of money and material wealth is within their reach, and they should look for the advantage. If money is lost, more can be gained. Legal matters may enter in, if honesty is lacking. Arguments may bring lawsuits and these can be drawn out. This is not a time for self interests or indulgence. Their principles and morals need to be well established, and tolerance and compassion kept at the forefront.

They should be developing a better existence for themselves and those they are now associating with.

They should follow all projects through to the end and keep their hand on the pulse of the work they are in control of. Constant attention must be paid to keeping themselves well balanced, mentally, financially and physically.

Their success comes through their helping and managing others to improve the quality of their life and station for the benefit of the whole.
Essence.70:
Present attitude toward life

They are questioning themselves and considering what it is they should be doing and in what direction they should be headed. This will be a part of the mental pressure they will have to endure before they reach an understanding of what it is that their life is lacking.

They should be developing a better existence for themselves and those they are now associating with.
Essence.71:
Present attitude toward life

Present attitude toward life

Their principles and morals need to be well established, and tolerance and compassion kept at the forefront.
Essence.73:
Present attitude toward life

They enjoy the idea, or desire, to experience new interests, opportunities, career, or to make connections with different people than those they have associated with previously. Present attitude toward life
